g.text: Successive same-sign peaks provide logarithmic decrement for an underdamped decay

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Synthetic decay record illustrates how measured peak amplitudes would be used; it is not experimental data. Same-sign peaks are one damped period apart,
linear viscous damping and one dominant mode are assumed. The assigned model hasωn10 rad/s andζ.05. Noise, multiple modes, nonlinearity, or peak selection
errors can invalidate the single-pair estimate.
